text: 你觉得，与其单独盯着某个人或某件事，不如利用时间了解整体情况，和不同的人交谈，听听他们各自的看法。
听着房间里的谈话，你逐渐明白聚集在此的大多数人只是把这当作一场社交活动。不过，现场也有不少学者和收藏家。考虑到镇民相对富裕，你猜这些物品会引来许多竞价。
你在宾客间走动时，碰巧注意到两名男子正低声交谈。他们似乎不想让别人听见，但如果耳朵够灵，或许能听出他们在说什么。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 34
text: Rather than single anyone or anything in particular out, you feel it would be best to use your time to get a general impression and speak to multiple people to get their points of view.

Hearing the talk around the room, you come to understand that most of the people who have gathered here are merely treating this as a social event. However, there are a fair number of academics and collectors in attendance as well. Judging by the relative wealth of the townsfolk, you imagine that there will be a lot of bids placed on the items.

While walking among the guests, you happen to notice a pair of men conversing in hushed tones. They seem to be trying to avoid being overheard, but a keen ear might be able to catch what is being said.
